title: Build source-faithful semantic projections and scoped evidence foundations
description:
Own reusable pack-side foundations that improve source fidelity and support bounded
discovery/capability consumers without creating a universal clause ontology.
Structured semantics are required where they faithfully represent source structure,
support discovery relationships, or feed a positively selected deterministic
capability. Model adjudication remains the default semantic authority outside
positive deterministic commitments.
acceptance_criteria:
- Foundations preserve source fidelity/provenance and fail closed when a declared bounded claim cannot be evaluated.
- Bounded source-obligation proofs identify their independently justified population; registry membership is never corpus completeness.
- Shared semantic/parser infrastructure is introduced only for demonstrated recurring source structure or real consumers.
- Evidence categories state exactly what they prove and do not prove.
- Unknown/unrecognized/unbound/unclassified/empty results never become satisfaction or absence.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
